newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr closes firmer on U.S. dlr correction.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr closes firmer on U.S. dlr correction.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished firmer on Friday as the U.S. dollar encountered correction in overseas markets, dealers said.
The local dollar closed at T$27.605 against Thursday's T$27.625 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$346.5 million.
Dealers said the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, which triggered U.S. dollar buying on Thursday, was largely discounted on Friday.
"The Taiwan dollar movements today reflected the U.S. dollar's recent slight correction overseas," said one dealer.
"Deng's death no longer influences the market," added the dealer at a foreign bank.
The Taiwan dollar is expected to move in a T$27.55-65 range for Saturday.
